news.title: UNI begins anniversary year with first day of classes
news.summary_en: UNI began a historic academic year as students returned to classrooms, just weeks before UNI marks 150 years since its first classes were held.

news.title: First-year teacher Miah Phalen prepares to welcome students
news.summary_en: For Miah Phalen, this back-to-school season is special. For the first time in many years, she’s not starting a new academic year as a student. This year, she’s the teacher, leading her own classroom at Weber Elementary School in Iowa City.

news.title: TheatreUNI announces 2026-27 season
news.summary_en: TheatreUNI at the University of Northern Iowa invites audiences to experience magic, humor, competition and unforgettable music during its 2026–27 season, “Wonderings and Wanderings.”
